description: Human only: answer a task waiting in needs_human. requeue returns it to the queue (granting one more attempt if the budget is spent); cancel ends it; revise_spec sends it to backlog and returns its spec to draft until the revised spec is approved again; reverify hands a submission whose verification kept erroring back to the verifier, once the verifier is fixed.
